ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system that ingests public financial filings, earnings call transcripts, and alt-data to surface a non-obvious financial insight and aggressively stress-test it against counter-arguments.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams receive one company, industry, or financial question and must uncover a non-obvious, evidence-backed financial insight.
ideas.title: AlphaThesis: Multi-Agent Financial Research & Falsification Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly automates the core requirement of uncovering non-obvious, evidence-backed financial insights using adversarial thesis falsification, matching successful patterns from high-level trading and research agent wins.

ideas.pitch: A natural language search and semantic analysis tool for retail and manufacturing buyers to uncover hidden margin erosion risks across fragmented public supplier data.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams receive one company, industry, or financial question and must uncover a non-obvious, evidence-backed financial insight.
ideas.title: SupplySignal: Procurement & Footprint Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines natural language semantic search over unstructured public data to present a rapid, interactive dashboard that judges can query live.

ideas.pitch: An automated anomaly detection system that correlates satellite shipping data, port congestion metrics, and macroeconomic indicators to predict supply chain disruptions for specific industries.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams receive one company, industry, or financial question and must uncover a non-obvious, evidence-backed financial insight.
ideas.title: MacroAnomaly: IoT & Logistics Supply Chain Stress Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses hard time-series anomaly detection algorithms to provide rigorous quantitative evidence rather than surface-level LLM summaries.

ideas.pitch: An analytical platform that evaluates corporate sustainability and financial disclosure reports for greenwashing, linguistic bias, and over-optimistic sentiment skew.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams receive one company, industry, or financial question and must uncover a non-obvious, evidence-backed financial insight.
ideas.title: BiasAlpha: Financial Sentiment and Disclosures Fairness Audit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a completely unique angle on financial analysis by auditing the reliability and bias of the underlying reporting text.

ideas.pitch: A 3-turn metacognition harness that tests multiple reasoning models against historical financial shock scenarios to determine which model configuration provides the most reliable signal.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams receive one company, industry, or financial question and must uncover a non-obvious, evidence-backed financial insight.
ideas.title: MetaSignal: LLM Reasoning Benchmark for Market Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages sophisticated multi-turn reasoning benchmarks that impress technical judges looking for rigorous validation methods.
